He asked for the steps to Narcan somebody, and Officer Garcia actually broke the whole thing down. Check on them, sternum rub, Narcan, then lay them on their side.

Real info. Respectfully, nobody in the comments was taking notes though.

Out on the block in Baltimore with the jack, the tools and a little man learning how to do brakes.

His pops had it right. Real men don't get jealous of other men teaching their kids. They say thank you.

Starting November they're giving free weekend lessons to the youth. No charge.
